meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入端到端加密的邮件消息通道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要在应用中接入端到端加密邮件消息。
copy.tagline_en: Add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.

howto.what: 装上后,宿主机器人会多出一个 DeltaChat 频道:消息走标准邮箱、默认带端到端加密;来自 DeltaChat 的新私聊或群聊会自动登记成消息组,可绑定到 agent。
howto.when: 当用户要求接入 DeltaChat 频道、配置邮箱式 IMAP/SMTP 账号,或把 DeltaChat 私聊/群聊绑定到 agent 时触发。

say.text: 请帮我把 DeltaChat 频道加到项目里。
say.note: 会做安装前检查并补齐适配器与依赖。

say.text: 配置 DeltaChat 的邮箱凭据并重启服务。
把 DeltaChat 私聊接到 agent,给我邀请链接。
say.note: 查询消息组并绑定 agent,显示邀请 URL/二维码。

howto.what_en: Once installed, the bot has a DeltaChat channel via a native adapter: messages flow over email with end-to-end encryption, and new DMs or groups are registered as messaging groups that can be linked to an agent.
howto.when_en: Trigger when the user asks to add a DeltaChat channel, configure an IMAP/SMTP mailbox for it, or bind a DeltaChat DM/group to an agent.

say_en.text: Please add the DeltaChat channel to this project.
say_en.note: Checks prerequisites, copies adapter, installs package.

say_en.text: Set the DeltaChat mailbox credentials in .env and restart.
say_en.note: Connects to IMAP/SMTP using the DC_* variables.

say_en.text: Wire my DeltaChat DM to an agent and show the invite link.
say_en.note: Finds the group, binds the agent, shows invite URL/QR.
